nytNews.title: Houthi Strike on Saudi Airport Kills 2 as U.S. Tells Some Diplomats to Leave
nytNews.author: Ismaeel Naar
nytNews.excerpt: The airport is in Dammam, which is near the headquarters of oil giant Saudi Aramco. For weeks, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi militia has been attacking the kingdom’s aviation and energy sectors.

nytNews.title: In Wake of Riots, French Authorities Ban Some Protests
nytNews.author: Catherine Porter
nytNews.excerpt: President Emmanuel Macron said the move was necessary “so that calm prevails.”

nytNews.title: Judge Restricts D.H.S. Field Operations Aimed at Unearthing Voter Fraud
nytNews.author: Zach Montague and Shawn Hubler
nytNews.excerpt: The ruling largely blocked homeland security agents from carrying out field interviews in nine states, including California, as part of a sprawling effort to find noncitizens registered to vote.

nytNews.title: Global Rush to Fix PHP Security Flaw Leaves Some Websites Offline
nytNews.author: Lynsey Chutel

nytNews.author: Brad Plumer

nytNews.author: Valerie Hopkins
nytNews.excerpt: Russia has sought to separate the war in Ukraine from potential business deals and diplomacy with the United States. Its efforts now appear to be working.

nytNews.author: John Branch
nytNews.excerpt: A coaster dares riders to be daring, with steep drops, high speeds and improbably tight curves. But safety has become a concern again after a man was thrown from his seat and died in Georgia.
